svg.title: Payment Component Architecture - Smart Contract Pattern v4.0 (Contract-First | Event-Driven | Multi-Channel | Provider-Agnostic | AI-Ready)

g.text: Payment Component Architecture - Smart Contract Pattern v4.0
- Order created ONLY when contract ready
- No order gaps for failed payments
- Contract states: draft → pending → committed → fulfilled
Payment Component v4.0 - Smart Contract Pattern:
Order numbers assigned only when ready
Request caching, 50-70% fewer queries (+50ms contract overhead)
